A facility where animal welfare and care truly come first, not for "profit reasons" but out of respect for the bonds we have with our four-legged friends and a desire to provide care.
The great professionalism of the medical staff, the kindness of the receptionist, and the presence of Dr. Daniele Corlazzoli make it the primary referral facility for neurology and orthopedics, not just in our region.
A huge thank you for your work!

⭐ **ONE STAR IS ALREADY TOO MUCH. A DEEPLY NEGATIVE EXPERIENCE.**

In August, we took our dog Ombra to the Corlazzoli Clinic for difficulty eating and pain in one leg. During the visit with Dr. Leonardo Cavaliere, we suspected a neurological problem. The response? **"You know where you are, right? We're at a neurological clinic. Your dog has nothing neurological."**

We were prescribed blood tests and an abdominal ultrasound. Despite some abnormal results, we didn't receive the promised comment or a response to my email requesting clarification.

At the end of September, Ombra's condition worsened dramatically: she could barely eat, had balance problems, and an abnormal neck position. At our veterinarian's recommendation, we performed an MRI scan at the same clinic. **Diagnosis: meningoencephalitis.** The doctor told us that Ombra had been suffering from it for at least a month.

**I wonder: if our suspicion had been investigated further in August, could we have started treatment earlier and possibly limited the risk of neurological damage?** I can't say for sure, but it's a doubt that will remain.

When I ask about the severity of the situation, the doctor replies: "The next 48 to 72 hours are crucial; the dog might not make it." I burst into tears and hear her reply: "Ma'am, I didn't tell you the dog was dying,"** followed by "I should go, I'm already two hours late." A kind of empathy that, personally, I found lacking.

During the two days of hospitalization, the promised updates arrived only at our request. On the day of discharge, despite the agreed-upon time and my recommendations, Ombra and the documentation were not ready. Our requests were met with rude and dismissive responses.

From our vet, we discovered that we didn't even know whether Ombra had received treatment that morning: **the information was neither included in the discharge form nor communicated verbally**. More than three hours after my written request, the clinic confirmed that it had not been administered.

The ending was surreal: I received a phone call from Dr. Daniele Corlazzoli, who informed me that I was no longer welcome and would not grant me any further appointments, claiming that I had shouted and threatened to call the Carabinieri. I dispute this account: I did not shout or threaten the staff. The reference to the Carabinieri was made while speaking to my sister, recalling a previous family experience.

When I expressed my disappointment with the initial visit, he replied: "I have the best doctors in Europe."

Today, fortunately, Ombra is improving thanks to the treatment and monitoring by our trusted veterinarian.

"I don't expect infallible doctors, but professionals capable of listening, communicating, and treating with respect those who are experiencing the fear of losing their pet."

From our experience, a total disappointment. "I will not return and I do not recommend this facility."
Thanks to Prof. Daniele Corlazzoli my Kinder puppy has come back to life... he's not a doctor. He's a Saint" thank you 🙏 for existing San Daniele. ❤️

I met Dr. Corlazzoli when he operated on my cat at another facility. He's an extraordinary person. I visited the newly opened veterinary neurological clinic for a checkup on my cat. I must say that the facility is a testament to Dr. Corlazzoli. Competent and empathetic doctors in a modern and well-organized clinic.

Helpful and friendly medical, paramedical, and administrative staff.
Veterinarians with top-notch neurosurgery.
Maximum empathy.

Professionalism and availability, even after a long time, for updates and periodic prescription requests.
A point of reference for my dog's health.
Professional and very kind clinic.

Satisfied.

Professional, and very welcoming with dogs, fantastic facility. Thank you.

The center is highly professional and highly recommended.
Excellent. Dr. Corlazzoli is a very competent and friendly person who started treating my dog ​​with epilepsy in the best possible way. Thank you.
A thousand thanks :)

A very well-equipped clinic with well-trained and helpful doctors, thanks also to the receptionists who are always kind and ready to answer any questions. My furry friend Milo and I will never stop thanking you. THANK YOU

A thousand thanks! :)

Years ago, the doctor operated on my Labrador for a herniated disc, and he made a perfect recovery. He recently examined my Alana. He was excellent, very thorough, and empathetic. I highly recommend him.
An exceptional center, my Maltese had hernia surgery and I found great professionalism and kindness.
We found great professionalism, expertise, and, above all, a great sense of humanity. Everyone was extremely helpful, attentive, and caring, both towards our dog and towards us.
Seriousness and professionalism.

Thank you so much Angelo 🥰 …
Thank you Donatella ❤️

Dear Dr. Corlazzoli and all the staff,
​We would like to express our sincerest and deepest thanks for everything you have done for our beloved dogs.
​Your extraordinary professionalism, combined with your extraordinary sensitivity and kindness, has been an immense source of comfort for us. You supported and guided us both during their treatment, fighting with us and for them, and during the most painful moment of their passing and in the aftermath.
​Knowing that our lifelong companions were in the hands of such dedicated, empathetic, and compassionate people has made this journey more bearable. We will never forget the care and respect with which you accompanied them until the very end, and the closeness you showed us after their loss.
​With immense gratitude, Danilo, Silvia, SUNNY, and LOLA ❤️
Thanks Francesca :)

My cat Goku was in terrible pain, and his condition was getting worse. Two years of various tests, X-rays, MRIs, ultrasounds, blood and urine tests, and various therapies were performed. Nothing worked. Then, from the last MRI, the cause was revealed: Goku had hydrocephalus. I was referred to the Corlazzoli Clinic. I left Sardinia at the end of April with Goku, not without difficulty and with so many worries. I was warmly welcomed at the clinic, waited a few minutes, and then met with Dr. Daniele Corlazzoli. He was so forthcoming, so clear in his explanations, so professional, and so empathetic. The surgery consisted of inserting a shunt to drain the excess fluid that, having no outlet, remained in the skull and was compressing the brain and cerebellum. The chances of surviving the surgery were 50/50. Upon admission, they gave me plenty of time to say goodbye to my cat, but then I had to return to Sardinia for work. I wasn't there when he underwent surgery, but they called me before and immediately afterward to tell me everything had gone well. They kept me updated every day with messages and videos. A week later, I went to pick him up and I already saw the first improvements. Today, my Goku is doing well, and I can't thank Dr. Corlazzoli and his entire team enough for saving him. Thank you so much, everyone!

My dachshund was practically paralyzed. Thanks to the vertebral surgery, Dr. Corlazzoli and his entire staff were able to get him back on his feet and give him a new chance.
A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Corlazzoli and his entire staff for their professionalism, expertise, and
humanity.
Thank you so much ❤️
Fantastic.... As an association, he helped us so much... We hope the legendary Sinner in his hands will never have any more problems...

As always, I had a great experience. The team of highly trained and kind doctors was excellent. Dr. Corlazzoli, who treats my dog, is a wonderful doctor—very talented, helpful, and empathetic.
I highly recommend the clinic to anyone with a problem with their four-legged friend! 😊
Wonderful clinic, convenient for parking.... kind and attentive staff... Prof. Corlazzoli is a very good professional and very humane and attentive to animal welfare ❤️❤️❤️
Finally, in North Rome, a veterinary clinic with top-notch veterinary specialists I've known for a long time. The setting is beautiful and there's convenient parking.
Thanks Vincenzo :)

For the rest, nothing to say.

Professionalism and empathy

New clinic, very comfortable environment.
Dr. Corlazzoli is a luminary in veterinary neurology and orthopedics, and one of the things I consider fundamental is the compassion with which he treats his furry patients. I highly recommend this clinic and its entire staff!

The doctor welcomed the dog for the examination, making him feel immediately at ease so he could better assess him. He then immediately informed us of what had happened in a clear and understandable manner. I must compliment Dr. Okonji and the entire organization.
Excellent facility with Dr. Cavaliere who is competent and available
My experience was extremely positive. Aside from their expertise and professionalism, what you don't always find in these clinics is the warmth and compassion that makes you feel at ease...

Excellent professionals, fantastic hospitality, and what never hurts, the clinic is very beautiful, with well-kept spaces full of greenery. We often need to go there to solve or address "problems" with our little ones, and finding a relaxing and pleasant environment is essential. Then there's Daniel Corlazzoli, in short, the TOP <3
Top

Professionalism combined with humanity make this clinic a top-notch facility for our beloved furry friends. Professor Corlazzoli is the best professional one could hope for: competent, clear, and reassuring. It was an absolutely positive experience.
competence, professionalism and humanity

Competence, kindness, and professionalism.
A guarantee.
A cutting-edge center with friendly, efficient staff and doctors
Dr. Corlazzoli, in addition to being an excellent doctor, is always available and attentive to his furry patients and to the anxieties of us owners.

An absolutely positive experience. A veterinary clinic that stands out above all for its top-notch professionalism and the quality of its care and diagnostics. Dr. Daniele Corlazzoli, who handled my case, was exceptional: extremely competent, attentive, and meticulous, but above all, clear and thorough in his explanations, managing to make even the most complex aspects understandable.
The staff was always friendly, kind, and welcoming. A special mention goes to the secretaries, who were truly patient and helpful, attentive to the needs of those who called or visited the clinic, even in times of greatest concern.
I also greatly appreciated the organization of the spaces, with excellent separation and distribution of the areas dedicated to dogs and cats, a particularly important aspect for reducing stress for the animals. The facility also offers high-level diagnostics, offers convenient parking, and is easily accessible even from outside the region.
A very well-organized facility, where competence, professionalism, and care for animals are combined with great availability to their owners. Highly recommended.

Dr. Corlazzoli and his staff have treated him each time with extreme professionalism and so much love. I live in another region, but the Corlazzoli Clinic is always my go-to. I will never stop being grateful and recommend this clinic to anyone who asks me for advice.
Very professional and kind

Professionalism, Kindness, and Humanity...Jack has made a great recovery after a very delicate operation. A heartfelt thank you ❤ to all the doctors and staff!
Jack and Cristina

The entire clinic staff was fantastic, incredibly kind and empathetic.
Thank you for everything.
Professionalism
Dr. Corlazzoli is a highly professional professional and I consider myself lucky to have met him many years ago.
Great professionalism and humanity.

Punctual and serious, they treat our four-legged friends as if they were their own... doing this job takes passion, and they have it.
Always the best

Perhaps even at the time of discharge, I expected more attention in giving us information about the post-operative recovery. Luckily, I was able to send a photo of the plaster they had left on my paw via WhatsApp because in the meantime it had swollen abnormally, but the doctor hadn't warned me of anything. Overall, however, an excellent experience.
Exceptional facility, but above all Dr. Corlazxoli who has always followed my dogs for more than 30 years is a real guarantee, I highly recommend.
Welcoming staff and Dr. Porcarelli very helpful, kind and very professional.
Highly competent and helpful staff. Excellent facility and absolutely reasonable prices.

Their absolute expertise and professionalism saved our poodle. Their great availability, kindness, and love for our little ones...highly recommended for all neuromuscular, neurological, and other issues.

A very positive experience.
The environment was clean and comfortable, even while waiting, and the staff was friendly and helpful. The doctors were not only professionals but also very humane and kind to us owners, even when we asked the most absurd requests or questions.
I felt reassured and knew my furry friend was in good hands.
A heartfelt thank you to all the clinic staff.
State-of-the-art facility and qualified staff. Dr. Okonji is always available and patient.
Excellent professionalism and hospitality.

He underwent surgery in October last year, and over the past 12 months, he has regained full functionality, so much so that since last summer, I haven't noticed any hesitation in his walking. Excellent experience, welcoming place, friendly staff, competent and empathetic doctors. High fees, but impeccable service.
Very good, empathetic, professional and very competent

As soon as we arrived, Nina was immediately examined, and the next day at 8:00 a.m. she had tests and an MRI. Unfortunately, it was a serious cervical hernia, requiring surgery. She underwent surgery that afternoon, and by the same evening, she was fine again!! 😊
I thank all the staff and Dr. Corazzali for their professionalism and kindness. Thank you so much.
Professionalism, humanity, empathy… what more could you want from a veterinarian?
Excellent facility, super competent and human doctors

A huge thank you to Dr. Corlazzoli for his professionalism, expertise, and the meticulous care he gave my Irisia. He's a meticulous, helpful, and deeply compassionate professional. I can't recommend him highly enough!
Kindness, precision and professionalism, the best you could ask for.
Friendly and competent staff, highly recommended

My experience at the Corlazzoli Clinic was truly unique....after having my dog, Whisky, examined at a clinic in Roseto...where they literally misdiagnosed him...when I went to them, all it took was a physical examination and an X-ray of his paw to get a precise diagnosis...osteosarcoma...subsequently supported by clinical and scientific tests that confirmed the clinical picture....they explained to me in great detail the surgery he would need to undergo to relieve the pain....
Total amputation of the paw...it was the only way to save his life...the surgery was performed perfectly by Dr. Sir...an exceptional doctor...empathetic and caring!!...in all honesty...after the surgery I didn't choose to undergo chemotherapy....I don't want to alter Whisky's quality of life in any way....I don't know...what will happen in the future....but one thing is certain, it's only thanks to them...true angels...if my Whisky is still with me today...that for now he's running...playing...as if nothing had happened...in the last 3 months of his life.....!!...Thank you so much for everything.....
Everything was top notch. My dachshund has had three surgeries by Dr. Corlazzoli's team. Everyone was professional. The welcome and facility were top notch.

I'm giving it 5 stars, but if I could, I'd put the entire galaxy and even the planets :) Super clinic with empathetic and highly trained staff. Besides Professor Corlazzoli, an undisputed legend, we've had several visits with Dr. Sara Canal, who is also truly exceptional and highly trained. The clinic is an essential point of reference for those who, like me, have wonderful French bulldogs that we love madly. THANK YOU FOR EXISTING!

The doctors were extremely knowledgeable, helpful, clear in their explanations, and extremely courteous. Thank you so much for helping us get back to running and playing despite the patient's lack of cooperation.
Fantastic and welcoming structure, highly professional and helpful staff.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for the professionalism and dedication you have shown with our little Bright <3

We were treated by Doctors Samuel and Cavaliere, two superb professionals who immediately understood Ciro's health problem, and directly by Professor Daniele Corlazzoli, who performed and reported the MRI scan Ciro underwent.
From the first contact, the relationship was cordial and friendly, with everyone being extraordinarily helpful.
The distinguishing feature is the passion and sincere love that everyone at the Clinic shows for my beloved Ciro, and also for the concerns of me, his owner.
I am truly pleased to be able to express my total and unconditional appreciation for all the attention given to Ciro and me during these very delicate times.
I have also, with great appreciation, subsequently recommended the facility to other owners.
Thank you, and we hope that with the help you are providing, Ciro will continue on the path to stability we have achieved!
Peter Oresta

I took my dog, who has walking problems, to the clinic to see the neurologist and physiatrist: two serious and dedicated professionals. I highly recommend her!!!
Doctors empathetic towards the neurological kitten of a few months.
Excellent doctor

The doctor was extraordinary, very kind, he examined my dog ​​and gave me all the necessary explanations, I had gone with many fears but the doctor was able to reassure me, with great professionalism and availability he answered all my doubts.

Now she's running around as happily as ever.
The extraordinary staff informed us how the surgery began. At the end of the procedure, Professor Corlazzoli contacted us to let us know the positive outcome, and when Grace woke up, they sent us the video.

Professional and empathetic

You can immediately sense the love and dedication he puts into his work and his animal care. Always available, attentive, and compassionate, he manages to instill great trust and peace of mind. Cavaliere) told us that the diagnosis was most likely not accurate. His tone and approach were very calm and knowledgeable and we immediately felt at ease. He was right and my dachshund was operated for an herniated disk and he is now happy and pain free. During and after the surgery the staff communicated with me via WhatsApp and kept me updated in a timely manner. Everything went smoothly. The staff is caring and friendly. Special thanks to Claudia (the lovely receptionist) who gave us so much attention when we needed it. I am very grateful for the whole experience at the Corlazzoli clinic and I highly recommend it.
